field_mappings.transformation: Parse the whole ABN cell as an ABN with the ABN checksum applied, without requiring a type label; reject invalid checksums and emit the 11-digit ABN unchanged.

unmapped_fields.reason: Name is the only native source for the required entity.legal_name, but the supplied documentation only says the report contains the name of each corporate tax entity and does not define it as the registered legal name, so no supported legal-name mapping is proposed; entity.legal_name remains unresolved.
Income year is a reporting-period label for the tax report, not an observation time or validity date for the entity claims, so it is not mapped to observed_time, valid_from or valid_to.
PRRT Payable $ is a financial amount with no canonical ontology field in the assignment subset; it is not an entity identifier, name, address or status.
